lines: She swiftly thrust with the end of her folded fan.
The upper lip, Adam's apple, and solar plexus. It was a three-pronged attack on his vital spots, which were no different from anyone's, even if he was a hulking orc.
The struck orc fainted in anguish, and fell forward with a thud.
She hadn't killed him. But he probably wouldn't be able to move for a good, long while.
That had been the final one. The other bodyguards were already taken down.
They weren't that strong; they just had large bodies and scary faces.
However, the surrounding passengers―the ruffians of the demonic capital―didn't appear to think so.
They were gazing at Mitsuki—who had not only fought off a molester, but taken down orcs in the blink of an eye—as though they were looking at a monster.
To Bosluk, the slave trader who had sicced them on her, she looked even scarier than that.
He contorted his craggy orc face in absolute terror,
Then, taking advantage of the fact that the train had just stopped at a station, escaped through the open door at full speed.
Mitsuki also rushed out of the train, and chased after the fleeing Bosluk.
Her shouts echoed through the nighttime station.
「I have something to ask you! Stop at once! Or you're in for some pain!!」
The slave trader did not stop.
There was no way he couldn't have heard her.
He had no intention of stopping.
Luckily, there was no one else in the station.
Mitsuki snapped open her fan, then built up just a little bit of wind power, and released it.
She swung her fan down forcefully, whereupon a small tornado broke out, about the size of a person, and headed straight for him.
The slave trader was caught up in that tornado in no time, and, after conspicuously tumbling across the ground, crashed into the wall at the end of the platform.
He was limp and groaning, but since that hadn't been intended to kill him, he would probably be all right.
Mitsuki snapped her fan shut, and approached him.
「I did tell you to wait, you know.」
Her opponent was a contemptible slave trader.
Mitsuki's tone was colder than usual.
「Eh? Molest, you say? Could it be that you have been doing that?」
Mitsuki glared scrutinizingly, and the slave trader frantically denied it.
「I-I-I'm tellin' you, I haven't! I-I didn't do anythin'!」
「Please don't lie to me. I already know that you're a slave trader, and you've sold off a Taimanin.」
「Wha?! Don't tell me you're a Taimanin?!」
Mitsuki nodded, at which point the slave trader shuddered, and suddenly began to prostrate himself on the ground.
「Hiihh!! P-Please forgive me! Turn a blind eye!」
「I only sold her. I didn't lay a hand on that Taimanin!!」
「In that case, kindly tell me everything about where you sold Sanada Homura-san.」
